data.name: Qadeer
data.gender_notes: Qadeer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is powerful and able to do what he intends. The name Qadeer carries the meaning “Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Qadeer usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and ability to fulfill one's purpose and intentions.
data.etymology: Qadeer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qadeer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: قادر
in_arabic.meaning: الله کی طاقت کا حامل، مضبوط، قوی
in_arabic.long_meaning: قادر اللہ کی طاقت کا حامل، مضبوط، قوی۔ قادر کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ جو کچھ چاہتا ہے وہ کر سکتا ہے، اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت کا مظہر۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں ذکر ہے، سورہ فاطر آیت 42، 'وہ سب کچھ کرنے کی طاقت رکھتا ہے'۔ قادر نام اللہ کے 99 ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو مسلمانوں کے لئے بہت مقدس ہے۔

in_urdu.name: قادر
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی طاقت کا حامل، مضبوط، قوی، توانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: قادر کا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی طاقت کا حامل، مضبوط، قوی، توانا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، اور مسلمانوں کے بچوں کے لئے ایک مقبول انتخاب ہے۔ قادر نام کی اہمیت اس لئے بھی ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कादिर
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की शक्ति का धारक, मजबूत, शक्तिशाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: कादिर नाम का अर्थ है भगवान की शक्ति का धारक, मजबूत, शक्तिशाली। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, और मुस्लिम समुदाय में बच्चों के लिए एक लोकप्रिय विकल्प है। कादिर नाम की जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं, और यह अल्लाह की शक्ति और सामर्थ्य का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: قادر
in_pashto.long_meaning: قادر د قادر، مضبوط، ځواکمن. دا نوم د الله تعالی د قدرت او ځواک د څرګندلو لپاره کارول کیږي. په افغانستان کې دا نوم ډیر مشهور دی او د مسلمانانو لپاره یو مقدس نوم ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Qadeer
in_english.long_meaning: Qadeer is an Arabic name that means powerful, strong, capable, able. It is derived from the Arabic root 'Q-D-R', which means to have power or ability. In Islamic tradition, Qadeer is one of the names of Allah, signifying His power and capability. The name Qadeer has been used throughout history in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing strength and divine power.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qadeer holds cultural significance in the Islamic community as it signifies strength, power, and ability to bring intentions into fruition. In this sense, it can serve as an inspiration for individuals to strive towards their goals and dreams, trusting in their innate ability to shape the course of their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Qadeer is a reminder of the power and omnipotence of Allah (God). It serves as a reminder that all power and ability ultimately come from God, and that we are merely His vessels through whom He can carry out His will. It encourages individuals to trust in God's plan for their lives and to be patient and steadfast in the face of challenges, knowing that with His help, they can overcome any obstacle.
